name: layer_strip
description: Electrical planning base (vpt/layer_strip.py, tools/strip_layers.py): which layers of a DXF stay when the base for the electrical plan is made. Lists hold BASE layer names (the part after <storey>_<nn>_[Abbruch_|Neubau_]), written for the toolkit's synthetic flat: replace them with the base names of your own drawing.
undecided_policy: A layer with content on no list is kept and flagged (could-not-tell) until it is decided: keeping loses nothing.
ignore_note: CAD's own layers (0, Defpoints, and VIEWPORTS, the layer a paper-space viewport is put on by default): left untouched, not classified.
drop_status_note: Layers with these status prefixes are dropped whatever their base name: demolished content is not wired. Neubau (new) stays.
